fact_text: SubDeli is a sub-sandwich and deli brand that began in Hyderabad, Sindh, and has since opened an outlet in Karachi.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SubDeli: How a Local Hyderabad Brand Took on a Global Chain | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-07)

fact_text: SubDeli's CEO, Faiz Ahmed, is an electrical engineering graduate who had event-organising and leadership experience before starting his own business.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SubDeli: How a Local Hyderabad Brand Took on a Global Chain | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-07)

fact_text: Kurkos Distro is a Hungarian-style dessert shop in Hyderabad, opened in 2019 by the SubDeli CEO and his wife; the CEO called it the founders' first restaurant.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SubDeli: How a Local Hyderabad Brand Took on a Global Chain | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-07)

fact_text: While holding a Karachi job, the founder commuted daily to Hyderabad to run the shop, reaching it by iftar time during Ramadan.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SubDeli: How a Local Hyderabad Brand Took on a Global Chain | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-07)

fact_text: The first restaurant had 12 seats.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SubDeli: How a Local Hyderabad Brand Took on a Global Chain | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-07)

fact_text: The restaurant's seating grew from 12 seats to 50 seats through reinvestment of its own earnings.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SubDeli: How a Local Hyderabad Brand Took on a Global Chain | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-07)

fact_text: As of the interview, the Kurkos Distro restaurant seats 100 persons.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SubDeli: How a Local Hyderabad Brand Took on a Global Chain | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-07)

fact_text: The business was bootstrapped: the founders invested savings from earlier event-organising work and reinvested all earnings, so growth was gradual rather than rapid.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SubDeli: How a Local Hyderabad Brand Took on a Global Chain | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-07)

fact_text: SubDeli was launched from the Kurkos Distro restaurant base, not as a separate investment.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SubDeli: How a Local Hyderabad Brand Took on a Global Chain | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-07)

fact_text: SubDeli's concept was born when an international sandwich chain left Hyderabad, leaving a gap caused by unavailable products and weak standardisation that the founders saw they could fill.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SubDeli: How a Local Hyderabad Brand Took on a Global Chain | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-07)

fact_text: The founders did not bring the Kurkos Distro dessert concept to Karachi because Karachi already has many cafes; they saw more value in a sub-sandwich brand that fills a gap.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SubDeli: How a Local Hyderabad Brand Took on a Global Chain | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-07)

fact_text: The expansion plan covers Karachi only, with multiple outlets planned, because the CEO sees Karachi as a huge market where the gap for this concept already exists.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SubDeli: How a Local Hyderabad Brand Took on a Global Chain | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-07)

fact_text: The Hyderabad outlet is being improved and renovated internally rather than scaled, because its dessert business is harder to scale than SubDeli's concept, the CEO said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SubDeli: How a Local Hyderabad Brand Took on a Global Chain | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-07)

fact_text: Karachi site selection starts by finding hotspot areas with food aggregators such as Foodpanda; the areas named are Gulshan North, Nazimabad, a Gulistan area, Tipu Sultan and Clifton.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SubDeli: How a Local Hyderabad Brand Took on a Global Chain | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-07)

fact_text: The CEO said SubDeli will expand in Karachi one area at a time, choosing the next hotspot after each is covered, with the aim of covering the whole city.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SubDeli: How a Local Hyderabad Brand Took on a Global Chain | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-07)

fact_text: Bread dough and sauces are produced at SubDeli's own commissary, which supplies all outlets so that taste and bread quality stay standardised across branches.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SubDeli: How a Local Hyderabad Brand Took on a Global Chain | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-07)

fact_text: The CEO said owning production and decision-making in Pakistan lets a local brand set and enforce standards directly, which becomes easier as more Karachi outlets are supplied from one commissary.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SubDeli: How a Local Hyderabad Brand Took on a Global Chain | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-07)

fact_text: The menu's chicken toppings include tikka, fajita and peri-peri, and its deli meats include pastrami, pepperoni, salami, turkey and tuna.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SubDeli: How a Local Hyderabad Brand Took on a Global Chain | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-07)

fact_text: SubDeli's signature sauces include a top-selling nacho cheese sauce and a chipotle sauce, both made in-house.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SubDeli: How a Local Hyderabad Brand Took on a Global Chain | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-07)

fact_text: The menu differs from international chains in breads, toppings, sauces and ordering style, with a 'we build' fixed-recipe option and a 'you build' option for customised orders.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SubDeli: How a Local Hyderabad Brand Took on a Global Chain | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-07)

fact_text: Salads follow the same model: a fixed recipe such as a Caesar salad, or customer-chosen toppings through the 'you build' salad option.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SubDeli: How a Local Hyderabad Brand Took on a Global Chain | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-07)

fact_text: The stated core purpose of the business is to use Pakistan-based and Pakistan-grown products and to support local vendors and local infrastructure.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SubDeli: How a Local Hyderabad Brand Took on a Global Chain | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-07)

fact_text: The CEO said local brands in Karachi's coffee and fried-chicken segments compete with and outperform international chains, and SubDeli's customer feedback supports this view.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SubDeli: How a Local Hyderabad Brand Took on a Global Chain | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-07)

fact_text: The CEO said international chains' weakness is follow-up and hands-on presence in each outlet, not their protocols, and that local ownership allows faster decisions.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SubDeli: How a Local Hyderabad Brand Took on a Global Chain | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-07)

fact_text: The interviewee said a consumer boycott of foreign brands in Pakistan shifted buyers from the belief that international is better toward supporting Pakistani brands.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SubDeli: How a Local Hyderabad Brand Took on a Global Chain | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-07)

fact_text: The CEO said the sub-sandwich segment has room for new players, since the United States has many sub brands and a new entrant can do what an incumbent cannot.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SubDeli: How a Local Hyderabad Brand Took on a Global Chain | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-07)

fact_text: By November 2025, other sandwich and salad concepts modelled on the SubDeli approach were opening in Karachi, the CEO said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SubDeli: How a Local Hyderabad Brand Took on a Global Chain | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-07)

fact_text: Restaurants faced a very difficult COVID-19 period in 2020; the Kurkos Distro founder had quit his job to scale in Hyderabad, and then the business shut down.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SubDeli: How a Local Hyderabad Brand Took on a Global Chain | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-07)

fact_text: During COVID-19 in 2020, the founders could not hire staff because of infection risk and resources were limited, so they made products at home and delivered them themselves.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SubDeli: How a Local Hyderabad Brand Took on a Global Chain | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-07)

fact_text: Food delivery platforms such as Foodpanda helped local brands reach customers and get deliveries to homes during the COVID-19 period, the CEO said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SubDeli: How a Local Hyderabad Brand Took on a Global Chain | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-07)
